تسترعفون (form X)
# تَسْتَرْعِفُونَ (tastarʕifūna) /tas.tar.ʕi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
# تُسْتَرْعَفُونَ (tustarʕafūna) /tus.tar.ʕa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
